diffs.diff: pin count: part has 4 (GND 3.3V SDA SCL), datasheet reading has 7 (GND 3.3V SDA SCL NC NO COM)
diffs.evidence: SparkFun's hookup guide pin table lists 'GND Ground In, 3.3V Power In, SDA Data Bi-directional, SCL Clock In' and separately 'NC Normally Closed Switch, NO Normally Open Switch, COM Switch Common Switch'. The second reading agrees with the model on the four logic pins (GND, 3.3V, SDA, SCL, same names and roles). NC/NO/COM are the relay's dry contacts on the 3-way screw terminal ('The Qwiic connectors and screw terminals also mean that no soldering is necessary'), which are galvanically isolated from the logic and switch the load (possibly mains), not pins a microcontroller wires to. The model already documents them in its description ('3-way NO/COM/NC screw terminal') and build notes, matching the repo convention for every other relay part (1-, 2-, 4-, 8-channel relay modules model only the control header and describe the NO/COM/NC terminals in text). So the 4-pin control interface in the model is correct and complete; the 3 extra entries are the contact terminal, not missing control pins.
